reviews.title: This app is amazing!
reviews.text:
I am a former mental health therapist who retired in 2004, and I never knew that such a simple method could help change people for the better quickly and independently. 

I most highly recommend this app and EFT to anyone who has physical or emotional pain, LIFE stress, insomnia, unhealthy cravings, wants to lose weight, or simply wants a better quality of life. 

This app walks you through every step so you don't have to do anything hard, all you have to do is decide you want to feel better and use it. 

I used to have a lot of trouble going to sleep, and then I would sleep for a couple of hours and wake up and have trouble going back to sleep. I also had debilitating physical pain after a slip and fall injury in August 2024. All of that improved fairly quickly because I used the app to go to sleep, and when I woke up earlier than I wanted to, I used the app to go back to sleep. Now I don't need it more than once a month.

Because the sleep meditations worked so well I then tried the "90 day challenge for pain relief," and it really helped tremendously. I have used this app for lots of other issues and have had great success getting better quickly in the privacy of my own home. 

It works if you work it, but won't help at all if you don't. You've got nothing to lose to try this and everything to gain.

I began to breathe and let go and allow myself to trust the process and have faith that everything is working out for me and my fur babies, that I am divinely guided and protected. Nick it was and is divine guidance that brought me to you. Tapping is truly a miracle that is bring miracles into my life, I use different spiritual tool  but Tapping really set things to right and I can’t not express how grateful I am , you and Jessica are such a blessing, I wish I could hug you guys , from the bottom of my heart with every fiber of my being THANK YOU, Peace and Blessings to you🤗💕🥰 🙏. reviews.title: 5 stars, 4 for if only
reviews.text: Personally and professionally, as a therapist, this app is 5 stars.  The 4 stars is for “if only.”  If only the app allowed you to record when you tap without the app, using your voice and thoughts. Manual and app as part of your streak and sessions. That is growth. What a testament to the app and tapping to see how powerful it is without being tethered to an electronic device. Now THAT is rewiring your brain.

reviews.title: Beware the free trial
reviews.text:
Update 14 July 26:
The company did make good on their offer to assist me when I emailed them. That said, I do still feel this needs more of a warning that the free trial is on condition of a year subscription, and if it’s said a reminder will come, then it should come. 

I will say EFT Tapping does seem like a decent evidence-based approach. 

—
Original 06 July 26:
Like many others, it seems, I didn’t realize the free trial I signed up for was attached to an annual trial. 

While yes, I realize that I am ultimately responsible for my failure to properly read, I’m also floored that the “we will email you before your trial ends” never happened.

Just please be aware of the $101 yearly subscription if you sign up for the free trial.

reviews.title: From Someone With OCD: This Is Life Changing
reviews.text: I saw ads for this app on Facebook. Like everyone else, I was extremely skeptical. But after suffering an anxiety spiral lasting days, I figured I had nothing to lose by trying it. I’m FOREVER thankful I did. I did one 8 minute session and when I started, my anxiety was 6/10. But the time I finished that session, it was 4/10. I figured “hey, this is actually kinda working…” so I tried another 9 minute session directly after. When that was done, my anxiety was at a complete 0/10. I felt peace. I felt relief. Like I could enjoy my day. I believe it is the combination of the physical tapping but also going through the practice of acknowledging your negative feelings and welcoming the positive really helps. I appreciate the guided process they provide as they walk you through it in each session. I would recommend this app to anyone because I think having those guided sessions is super helpful compared to just tapping alone. I’ve been doing sessions every day since I got this app and I feel like it’s literally changing my brain long-term. It’s so amazing knowing that there is something that can provide me with immediate relief if my thoughts start to spiral! I signed up for the free trial but will definitely be paying the subscription because this is invaluable. 🥹
